items.title: Do Narratives Lead Prices, Or Follow Them? Sentiment, Price Positioning, And Measurement Disagreement In Bitcoin
items.claim: Bitcoin prices predict sentiment, reversing the leading-indicator interpretation of published sentiment indices.

items.title: Epistemic Calibration and Latency Advantages of System One Probabilistic Agents in Limit Order Book Microstructure: An Empirical and Multi-Agent Evaluation
items.claim: Autoregressive LLMs encounter prohibitive latencies (3.5–12 seconds) when deployed in electronic financial markets.

items.title: Silicon Cartels: Detector Orientation in Multi-Agent Pricing Testbeds
items.claim: Testbed detector calibration against low-variance controls reverses polarity in higher-variance deployment environments.

items.title: Agentic Regulatory Intelligence: A Human-Supervised Multi-Agent System Architecture for Financial Crime Pattern Monitoring and Regulatory Guidance Generation
items.claim: Regulatory guidance for financial crimes lags 12–57 months after typology emergence, extending criminal opportunities.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence, Model Monoculture, and Bank Credit Allocation
items.claim: AI development increases convergence in bank credit allocation, reducing system-wide lending diversity.
